agentWalletSetDigest(uint256,address,add.details: Digest over `AgentWalletSet(agentId, newWallet, owner, deadline)`      with domain {name, version, chainId, verifyingContract} = this      mock — mirrors the reference `_hashTypedDataV4`.

getApproved(uint256).notice: ERC-721 single-token approval (part of the auth triangle:         validationRequest callers, isAuthorizedOrOwner semantics).

getMetadata(uint256,string).notice: Read arbitrary metadata. Returns "" for unknown keys.

isApprovedForAll(address,address).notice: ERC-721 operator approval (part of the auth triangle).

isAuthorizedOrOwner(address,uint256).notice: True if `spender` is the owner, approved for the token, or         approved for all. Drives the reputation self-feedback guard.

ownerOf(uint256).notice: ERC-721 owner of the agent identity NFT.

register(string).notice: Mint a new agent identity NFT; caller becomes owner.         The reference also records the caller as the initial         agentWallet.

setAgentURI(uint256,string).notice: Update the agent's metadata URI. Owner/operator only.

setAgentWallet(uint256,address,uint256,b.notice: Bind (or rebind) the on-chain agent wallet. Requires a         signature from `newWallet` (ECDSA or ERC-1271) over         `AgentWalletSet(agentId, newWallet, owner, deadline)` with         the registry's EIP-712 domain, and         `deadline <= now + 5 minutes` on-chain.

setMetadata(uint256,string,bytes).notice: Arbitrary metadata key/value. Owner/operator only;         the "agentWallet" key is reserved (registry-managed).

unsetAgentWallet(uint256).notice: Clear the agent wallet binding. Owner/operator only.
